contentConstraints.objectPremise: An illustrative physical bench apparatus, not a sheet or card metaphor. Piece count, geometry, colors, composition and mechanisms are not prescribed.

beatMeanings.meaning: Explain firmware and bring-up in ordinary language, introduce Ada's code-to-physical-check contribution and the question the ending will answer.
Use the explicitly illustrative Sleep, Measure, Transmit loop to explain power-state scheduling without inventing actual firmware topology, durations or measured values.
Connect a command, board response, fixture access and observation; keep Ada's firmware, scheduling and fixture separate from the colleague's PCB and analogue front end.
Measured sleep and transmit current plus an assumed reporting interval support a two-year projection. A separate bench run supports 72 hours observed, not the projection's validation.

Answer the opening through firmware/scheduling and the fixture connecting code to an observable check. Bound it to six bench-tested of forty assembled engineering samples, none sent to customers, and a preliminary emissions pass with full qualification unfinished.
